documents.instruction: The three-part model (registry declares, signed release admits, federation proxies without widening) and the surface list must match src/registry.mjs and the two entry points.
Every command and pasted output must reproduce on a fresh clone with a toy release minted by docs/examples/mint-toy-release.mjs; re-execute after any CLI, MCP, or admission change.
The registry table, the configured/active derivation, and the operator-filter semantics must match SURFACES, surfaceConfigured, and activeSurfaces in src/registry.mjs.

The verification order, launch-time validation, environment boundary, handshake verification, call-time gates, and the Skarbiec/Finance boundaries must match src/registry.mjs and src/signed-manifest.mjs.
Usage text, exit codes, refusal sentences, and JSON output shapes must match src/cli.mjs; captured outputs must reproduce against a toy release.
The method table, error code-to-sentence table, agent-identity rules, federation/namespacing behavior, and the las__onboarding schema must match src/mcp.mjs verbatim.
Every environment variable Las reads must appear here with its reader, effect, and default; the per-surface allowlists must equal the envAllowlist entries in src/registry.mjs.
The ownership boundaries, data flow, trust-boundary table, process model, and zero-dependency claim must match the source and package.json.
Every quoted sentence must exist verbatim in src/ or reproduce from a real refused run; re-capture the fixtures after any error-string change.
The mint-to-verified-surface transcript must reproduce end to end with docs/examples/mint-toy-release.mjs on a workspace with a built brama sibling.
Both wire transcripts (happy path and the nine-request refusal batch, including completion-order placement of id 5) must reproduce verbatim against a toy release admitting only brama.
The field table, current-registry table, and every spawn-time invariant sentence must match SURFACES, validateCwd, validateCommand, and buildChildEnvironment in src/registry.mjs.

File contracts, envelope/trust-store/manifest schemas, domain separator, strict-JSON refusals, and watermark semantics must match src/signed-manifest.mjs and src/strict-json.mjs, refusal sentences verbatim.
The five-stage pipeline, its memoization semantics, and every refusal sentence must match signedManifest, surfaceConfigured, activeSurfaces, connect, and authorizeTools in src/registry.mjs.
The surface lifecycle (spawn-per-command CLI, memoized MCP federation), namespacing, and failure semantics must match connect, handshake, and buildFederation.

The four call gates, the environment boundary, the full Skarbiec taxonomy/ceilings/result contracts, and the Finance policy must match the constants and authorize* functions in src/registry.mjs, sentences verbatim.
The journey screens, action set, state-file shape and permissions, bundle validation, and transport behavior must match src/onboarding.mjs; the captured journey and state file must reproduce offline.
